edition_note: Yes/no flags now admit integer SQL columns for review; generic numeric 0/1 values alone do not auto-assign.

domain_prior.note: T4 — applied to every type without its own domain_prior detector; shown as "prior" in the score breakdown, never counted as evidence; max 0.2.

domains.label: Indian SMB finance
domains.description: GSTIN, PAN, HSN, IFSC, GL accounts and adjacent Indian finance fields.

domains.label: Generic finance
domains.description: Amount, currency, dates, identifiers shared across finance domains.

domains.label: Generic logs
domains.description: Log levels, services, endpoints, latency, HTTP status, IDs.

domains.label: Product analytics
domains.description: Event-stream columns from Mixpanel / Amplitude / PostHog exports: event names, user/session IDs, properties, UTM attribution.

domains.label: Geography and location
domains.description: Latitude/longitude, city, state/region, district, postal code, address.

domains.label: Marketplace and listings
domains.description: Listing/host IDs, room type, availability, reviews, minimum stay — Airbnb-style short-let and marketplace exports.

domains.label: Public sample datasets
domains.description: Outcome/demographic roles from common teaching datasets (Titanic): survival, passenger class, sex, age, fare, embarkation.

domains.label: Retail and transactions
domains.description: Order/invoice IDs, lifecycle status/timestamps, payment installments, product categories/dimensions, SKU, quantity, and customer IDs — retail and e-commerce exports.

domains.label: Media and content
domains.description: Titles, credits (director/cast), content rating, genre, release year, media type — catalog / streaming exports.

domains.label: HR and people
domains.description: Employee identity, lifecycle, management, recruiting, performance, engagement, attendance, compensation, and tenure — HRIS and people-analytics exports.

domains.label: Sensitive data (PII / secrets)
domains.description: Credentials + sensitive identifiers (API keys, tokens, private keys, AWS keys, credit cards, SSN, passport, national ID, DOB, MAC, crypto wallets) — from Purview/GCP/Presidio detector families. Drives sensitivity badges + anonymize-sink defaults (secret→redact, pii→hash, financial→bucket).

domains.label: Real estate
domains.description: Property type, bedrooms/bathrooms, square footage and sale price — real-estate listing and transaction exports.

domains.label: Education
domains.description: Student IDs, grade level, course, score and completion status — school / LMS / assessment exports.

domains.label: Healthcare and clinical
domains.description: Patient / encounter IDs, diagnosis codes, length of stay and claim amounts — clinical, claims and EHR exports. Sensitivity-marked (secret/financial).

domains.label: Public sector and demographics
domains.description: Country/year indicator panels, tiers/ranks, population, households, median income, unemployment rate, and age bands — census, civic, and open-data aggregates.

domains.label: Scientific and measurements
domains.description: Sensor IDs, temperature, humidity, pressure and measurement units — IoT / environmental / lab sensor exports.

domains.label: Risk, fraud and security
domains.description: Fraud flags, risk scores, authorization results, device IDs and card-last-4 — fraud / payments-risk / security exports. Sensitivity-marked.

domains.label: Banking, payments and lending
domains.description: Transaction amounts/fees, debit-credit indicator, interest rate and loan principal — payments, banking and lending exports.

domains.label: Insurance
domains.description: Policy IDs, premium, sum insured, claim status and line of business — insurance policy / claims book exports.

domains.label: Customer support and success
domains.description: Ticket IDs/status, priority, first-response time and CSAT — helpdesk / support / success exports.

domains.label: Supply chain and procurement
domains.description: Purchase orders, warehouses, inventory, lead time and unit cost — procurement / inventory / logistics exports.

domains.label: Energy and utilities
domains.description: Meter IDs, kWh usage, kW demand, tariff codes and outage minutes — utility metering / grid / energy exports.

domains.label: Manufacturing and quality
domains.description: Work orders, produced quantity, defect counts, yield rate and quality result — manufacturing / production / QC exports.

domains.label: Legal, contracts and compliance
domains.description: Contract IDs/types/values, renewal and compliance status — legal / contract-management / GRC exports.

domains.label: Nonprofit and fundraising
domains.description: Donor IDs, donation amounts, campaigns, funds and recurring flags — nonprofit / fundraising / CRM exports.

domains.label: Research and scholarly
domains.description: Paper IDs/titles, publication year, citation counts and venues — scholarly / bibliometric / knowledge-graph exports.

domains.label: Government operations
domains.description: Agencies, programs, application status, processing time and benefit amounts — public-service / benefits / civic exports.

domains.label: Agriculture and food systems
domains.description: Farm IDs, crop type, yield, acreage and market price — agriculture / food-systems exports.

domains.label: Sports and events
domains.description: Match IDs, teams, scores, attendance and results — sports / events / fixtures exports.
